data.name: PageTitle
data.value: Engineering Dossier — How It Was Made

data.name: HeroAbstract
data.value: This document chronicles the construction of the Dusk of Coding platform — built without writing most of its code, directed by human architecture, assembled by AI.

data.name: MetaStackValue
data.value: Blazor Server · Keycloak · Roslyn · Gemini · Polly

data.name: DirectiveBody1
data.value: The era of manual coding is setting. Soon, raw source code will look like hieroglyphs — obscure archaic symbols. The engineer of the future is not a typist, but a code archeologist and system conductor who can decode and direct AI-generated structures.

data.name: DirectiveBody2
data.value: Dusk of Coding exists at this threshold. A platform built specifically to prove that the most powerful workflow is not human alone, nor AI alone — but a precise, disciplined collaboration between the two.

data.name: SystemMapIntro
data.value: What was built. The platform is a modular monolith applying Clean Architecture — separating concerns across five distinct service boundaries.

data.name: AbyssIntro
data.value: THREE CRITICAL FAILURES. ALL AI-GENERATED. ALL RECOVERED.

data.name: Incident001_Symptom
data.value: SYMPTOM: HTTP 431 — Request Header Too Large

data.name: Incident001_RootCause
data.value: ROOT CAUSE: Correlation cookies multiplied on every OIDC redirect. SameSite=None policy misaligned between container and browser.

data.name: Incident001_Resolution
data.value: RESOLUTION: Memory-backed ITicketStore eliminated cookie growth. Proactive cleanup on sign-out.

data.name: Incident002_Symptom
data.value: SYMPTOM: Authentication succeeded inside the container, failed silently in the browser

data.name: Incident002_RootCause
data.value: ROOT CAUSE: Keycloak's token issuer URL differed between the Aspire internal network and the browser-facing address. JWT validation failed on every real request.

data.name: Incident002_Resolution
data.value: RESOLUTION: Decoupled Authority from MetadataAddress. Issuer validation aligned with the browser-reachable endpoint.

data.name: Incident003_Symptom
data.value: SYMPTOM: DbUpdateConcurrencyException on every parallel submission

data.name: Incident003_RootCause
data.value: ROOT CAUSE: DTOs were replacing tracked entities instead of mapping properties onto them. The Change Tracker lost ownership and threw concurrency exceptions.

data.name: Incident003_Resolution
data.value: RESOLUTION: Property-level mapping onto tracked entities. Update() reserved for detached objects only.

data.name: ResolutionBody
data.value: The architecture eventually collapsed under its own generated complexity. The AI components were logically sound in isolation — but they tore each other apart in a distributed environment. The solution was not to abandon the methodology. We mapped the underlying logical failures and designed highly surgical, Socratic prompts — forcing the AI to interrogate its own flaws, trace the root cause, and piece the system back together without destroying what already worked.

data.name: ResolutionTerminalLine2
data.value: > Hypothesis: Cookie policy mismatch on redirect...

data.name: GalleryIntro
data.value: The actual directives. Three of the twenty prompts that shaped this platform — from initial architecture to surgical incident resolution.

data.name: Gallery_Panel1_Desc
data.value: The original directive that birthed the Roslyn execution environment and the Clean Architecture scaffold.

data.name: Gallery_Panel1_Snippet
data.value: Role: Senior .NET Architect. Build a secure compilation service. Use Roslyn. Isolate in a collectible ALC. Enforce sandbox: 5s timeout, no IO, no reflection.

data.name: Gallery_Panel2_Desc
data.value: The surgical prompt that diagnosed the Keycloak dual-network issuer mismatch and the HTTP 431 death loop.

data.name: Gallery_Panel2_Snippet
data.value: Context: Authentication succeeds in container. JWT validation fails in browser. Diagnose issuer mismatch: Authority vs MetadataAddress. Decouple and align with browser-reachable endpoint.

data.name: Gallery_Panel3_Desc
data.value: Instructing the AI on how to critique student code using the Socratic method — never giving the answer directly.

data.name: Gallery_Panel3_Snippet
data.value: You are a strict Socratic code reviewer. Do NOT provide corrected code. Return a structured JSON: questions only. Language: Hungarian. Tone: precise, direct.

data.name: ManifestoLine1
data.value: The methodology works. The system is stable. The platform is live.

data.name: ManifestoLine2
data.value: This is what vibecoding looks like when the human is the architect.
